pose: An expansive underwater landscape composition showcasing a diverse Jurassic marine reptile ecosystem arrayed across a sunlit pelagic shelf sea. In the immediate foreground, a streamlined ichthyosaur (Stenopterygius) glides gracefully through the blue water, its large eye catching the sunlight and its dolphin-like tail fin beating smoothly in a three-quarter profile. On the opposite side of the foreground, a classic long-necked plesiosaur arches its neck elegantly, using its four large flippers to hover above the dark-grey shale floor. Along the vibrant midground, a crocodilian-like marine thalattosuchian (Metriorhynchus) actively pursues a school of fish, its armored skin and paddle-like limbs cutting through the water. Anchoring the deep background, the massive, imposing silhouette of an apex pliosaur cruises effortlessly through the open, deep-blue water column, casting a powerful sense of primeval scale beneath a canopy of shimmering overhead light rays.

visual_notes.flora_fauna: Scattered ammonite shells resting on the flat shale floor, with schools of fast-moving cephalopods in the water column.
visual_notes.lighting: Shimmering, high-contrast aquatic light filtering down from the ocean surface, illuminating floating organic matter and highlighting the distinct body shapes.
